requests.title: A production standing adult body, with head, hair and wardrobe that fit it

consumer.playerVisibleUse: The player's own character, standing in the room the title screen shows them.

requests.whyNeeded: Five production rooms are registered and painting. Not one person can be composed into any of them, so every character-bearing surface falls to a room with a name on it. This is the single asset that unblocks the most surfaces at once.

inventoryCheck.found: Four standing cells arrived on the Packet 71 body sheet — two standing-neutral and two standing-conversational — in one consistent family measured at 6.8 to 7.2 heads tall. The figures are right. The silhouette is not: it carries a green contour on 67 to 80 percent of its soft-edge pixels, which the approved style authority does not have and which is plainly visible at the ~250 plate pixels a body actually paints at. Reconciled against the preserved assets: seven adult morphologies are now banked and measured - fat, skinny, average and older figures across both presentations, plus a three-pose supplement - as fifty-one morphology-reference components inside a hundred-and-eleven-component review.
inventoryCheck.shortfall: The cells are banked under art/generated/candidates/ocd-p71/bodies with per-cell measurements in art/qa/p71/source_intake_dispositions.json. Every one is REVISE. No attachment anchors are authored, because D-068 requires them measured from the raster that ships and this raster is being re-exported. The preserved morphologies do not answer it either: every one of the hundred and eleven components reports eligibleAsProductionCharacterBody false, because each source cell sits under the 1696x2528 standing floor and the pipeline never enlarges a raster.

generationRecipe: One adult body in a relaxed standing pose, facing the camera, whole figure inside the canvas with the feet clear of the bottom edge.
True transparency everywhere that is not the figure. No painted ground, no shadow baked into the alpha.
Neutral undergarment-level body so tops, bottoms and footwear composite over it; not a finished outfit.
Grounded semi-realistic illustrated rendering matching the style authority. Not photographic, not cartooned.
No face or hair painted into the body: the head and hair are separate components.
acceptanceCriteria: Magic bytes are PNG and the alpha channel carries real per-pixel transparency, not a matte.
Six named semantic anchors descend the body in order, with the garment hips at or below the pelvis root.
Composes with a released head, hair, top, bottom and footwear into a complete plan with no missing layer.
Human visual approval recorded separately from intake acceptance.

requests.title: Re-export the adult body sheet without the green silhouette contour

consumer.playerVisibleUse: Any character standing or sitting in any of the six production rooms.

inventoryCheck.found: The 5056x3392 eight-pose sheet, measured here. Fully transparent pixels carry zero colour, so the background is clean; the defect is confined to the partially-transparent edge, where 67-80 percent of pixels per cell are green-dominant at a mean of roughly (43,79,30). It totals 8.4 percent of the figure's own opaque area. A CORRECTED SINGLE POSE ARRIVED DURING THIS RUN: Drive root IMG_5192.PNG, 5056x3392 RGBA, uploaded 2026-09-04 14:24. It is the standing-conversational pose from this same family with ZERO green-dominant soft-edge pixels, measured the same way — so the fix is confirmed possible and this request is now about re-exporting the remaining seven poses the same way. It is an unclassified Drive-root upload with no managed copy, so it was measured but NOT ingested. Reconciled against the preserved assets: IMG_5192.PNG is now in the repository rather than only in Drive, and it shows the green contour fix is achievable inside this art family.

Removing it here would mean rewriting the colour of pixels I cannot verify the correct value of, which is a repair the pipeline should not make silently. IMG_5192.PNG does not close it: at 5056x3392 it is the same sheet resolution, so a clean re-export at that size still fails the body floor. The ask is a re-export at production resolution, not only a clean edge.
